_comment: Seed terms for the monthly demand scan (monthly.mjs collectDemand). Bing's GetRelatedKeywords expands each seed into queries people actually searched, with Bing-wide impressions. It expands semantically, so a result is kept only if it contains every word in the seed's `must` list (default: every word of the seed). `block` drops look-alikes (currency codes, logins, other products). Seeds stay inside the CLAUDE.md §2 niche: T&M, embedded, industrial automation. 'covered' = areas the catalogue already serves (find adjacent gaps); 'adjacent' = niche areas with no tool yet (find new demand). Editing this list is T1; building anything it surfaces is T2.
